name: agency-brainstorm
displayName: Agency Brainstorm — Brand & UI Decision Room
description: Standing senior agency for brand, marketing, UX/UI, motion and digital-platform decisions, chaired by the Managing Partner. 16-role standing panel now including a Lead Information Architect, a Taxonomy & Metadata Lead / Content Ontologist, a Navigation & Wayfinding Designer, a Design-System & UI Consistency Lead (DesignOps/Platform Design Systems governance) and an Experience Governance Executive (CXO), so that how information and functionality are organised, how navigation is structured, and how consistent layout and interaction are across every interface are all gated seats. Blocking Phase 0 access gate: the panel must load the organisation's brand system and ALL of its design systems before any round. Senior Copywriter gates every user-facing string.
author: Marcus (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: MANDATORY to invoke before making or evaluating any brand-positioning or UI/UX/experience decision (including user-facing copy); read SKILL.md, then run the phased session (ground -> research -> >=10 consensus rounds with Senior Copywriter gate -> 1-5 options). Ecosystem affiliation lines must use 'This product is part of …' (never bare 'Part of …').
usage.designers: The agency roster, the session protocol, copy laws, and the option deliverable format.
usage.founders: A repeatable, senior decision room for important brand, product, and copy decisions.

dependencies.brand: the invoking context's brand skill (e.g. a *-brandsystem skill); loaded as locked upstream truth. Absent -> new-brand intake.
dependencies.designSystem: the invoking context's design-system skill (e.g. a *-designsystem skill); loaded for tokens/components/effects/prohibitions. Absent -> new-brand intake.
